description: This PHP class defines a console command 'CrowdinCommand' for the Goteo project, used to import and update translator data from Crowdin API, and to update the README.md file with translator info.

classes.name: CrowdinCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing Crowdin project data and updating README with translator info.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command name, description, options, arguments, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that triggers reading or updating Crowdin data based on input.

methods.name: readme
methods.description: Fetches translator data from Crowdin API and updates README.md with the list of contributors.
